items.description: A modern multi-purpose sports and entertainment complex in Diamniadio, hosting high-profile international basketball matches and concerts.
The town hall of Dakar, a historic building that serves as the administrative center for the city's government and municipal services.
One of the largest mosques in West Africa, known for its intricate design and impressive capacity. It is a major center for worship and community gathering in Dakar.
A popular market in Dakar renowned for its colonial architecture and vibrant selection of fresh food, flowers, and local crafts.
The residence and studio of renowned sculptor Ousmane Sow, now a cultural landmark honoring his life and work.
A local agricultural farm focusing on regional crop cultivation and rural development, contributing to the livelihoods in the Kolda area.
A unique park area showcasing the natural environment and local ecological diversity, popular for nature activities.
An agricultural zone in Tambacounda dedicated to cotton production, which is a major contributor to the local agricultural economy.
A poultry farming facility in the Thiès region, providing essential agricultural products and supporting food supply in the area.
A designated recreational beach area popular with families and children, providing a safe space for leisure and outdoor activities.
A protected wildlife reserve featuring a diverse ecosystem, offering visitors opportunities to see local fauna and forest environments.
A botanical garden in Dakar displaying a collection of regional plant species and providing a tranquil green space within the city.
A major agricultural project in the Podor region focused on large-scale tomato cultivation for regional markets.
